alt: Biliary system shown in situ with the liver, gallbladder, stomach, duodenum, pancreas, spleen and kidneys. Bile drains from the intrahepatic ducts to the right and left hepatic ducts, the common hepatic duct, and - after the cystic duct joins from the gallbladder - the common bile duct, which meets the pancreatic duct before entering the duodenum. Structures are numbered 1-22 and the printed key is missing from this version of the figure.
